'''Tedn Dahai''' was a [[Bith]] [[musician]] who played a [[fanfar]] as a regular member of the [[band]] [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes]]. Dahai was present when the band played at [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina]] in [[Mos Eisley]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="USW" />

{{Char-stub}}
